paite: Na lak ua kidounate leh kinaknate koi a kipan hong suak ahi ua? Hiaite na pumpi hiangte ua kidouna bawl nak, na nopsak utna ua kipan a hong suakkhete ahi kei ua hia?
heading: Kisaktheihna Siatna Bul Ahi
english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

paite: Na lunggulh ua, na nei tuan kei ua, huchi in tual na that uh. Na eng ua, na ngah thei tuan kei ua, huchi in na kidou ua, gal na bawl uh. Na nget louh ziak un, na nei kei uh.
english: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

paite: Na ngen ua, na nget diklouh ziak un na ngah kei uh, na nopsak bawlna ding lel ua zat na tup ziak un.
english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

paite: Nou angkawm hatte aw, khovel lawm hihna zaw Pathian melma hihna ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Huaiziak in khovel lawm hih ut peuhmah Pathian melma in akibawl nak hi.
english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

paite: Ahihkeileh eimah a teng Kha in, "Haza khop hial in ahon deih chih Laisiangthou in agen bangmah lou in na ngaihtuah ua hia?"
english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

paite: Himahleh ama'n hehpihna tamsem ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in Laisiangthou in, "Pathian in mikisatheite adou a, kingaineute bel hehpihna ape nak hi," achih.
english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian ah kitulut un. Diabol dou un, hileh noute ahon taimangsan ding hi.
english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

paite: Pathian naih unla, huchi in ama'n ahon naih ding. Khialte aw, na khut uh silsiang un; lungsim thuah neite aw, na lungtang uh hihsiangthou un.
english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

paite: Lungkham unla, suun unla, kapkhia un. Na nuih uh suunna suak henla, na lungnopna uh lungngaihna suak hen.
english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

paite: Toupa mitmuh in kingaineu un, huchi in ahon hihlian ding hi.
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

paite: Unaute aw, kigensetuah kei un. Kuapeuh in a-unau agensiat hiam vai ahawmkhumleh, dan gensia a vaihawmkhum ahi; dan na gensiatleh dan zuimi na hi kei a, vaihawmpa na hi zaw hi.
heading: Unau Gensiat Dan Bohsiatna
english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

paite: Dan pepa leh vaihawmpa, amah hondam theipa leh hihmang theipa khat lel a-om hi; nang na vengte vaihawmkhum kua kisa na hia?
english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

paite: Tu'n ah noute'n ngai un, "Tuni hiam zingchiang hiam in, huai khopi ah i hoh ding ua, huai ah kum khat i va taam ding ua, i sumsin ding ua, punna i mu ding," chite aw.
heading: Mihausate Ngaihtuah Khelh
english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

paite: Zingchiang a bang hong om ding ahia chih na thei kei uhi. Na hinna uh bang ahia? Tuimei sawt lou kal a hong dawk a, mang nawn lel bang na hi uhi.
english: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

paite: Huchi in "Toupa'n pha asakleh i dam dia, hiai hiam, huai hiam i hih ding," na chih ding uh ahi.
english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

paite: Himahleh na ki-otsaknate uh na suang zaw ua, huai bang suanna tengteng gilou ahi.
english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

paite: Huchi in kuapeuh thil hoih ding thei a hih tuan lou zaw amah a ding in khelhna ahi.
english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
